title: narcissus macrolobus
intro: Narcissus macrolobus, commonly known as the large-leaved narcissus or broad-leaved daffodil, is a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus macrolobus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects and are often studied for their potential in developing new medicines.
